AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Harvesting and Storage.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Poultry Rearing in a Fold and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Pest and Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Animal Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving animal products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
